text: Local daycare is interested in updating the hours for their drop off and pick up zone in order to better serve residents and guardians.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing maximum 10-minute parking regulation in effect from 9:15 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., 12:15 p.m. to 12:45 p.m. and 2:15 p.m. to 2:45 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Glen Manor Drive, between Avion Avenue and a point 35.5 metres south of Queen Street East, to be in effect from 8:15 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., 12:15 p.m. to 12:45 p.m. and 3:15 p.m. to 3:45 p.m., Monday to Friday.
